item: libyaml loader refuses documents nested past 256 levels; the C composer crashed the process at 23,925 levels
summary: load_safe_yaml counts nesting from libyaml's event stream and raises YAMLDepthError (a YAMLError) past 256 levels; the pure path turns RecursionError into the same error. Measured on an 8 MiB stack: parses to 23,681 levels (maps) / 25,876 (sequences), segfaults at 23,925 / 26,364; the 512 KB and 1 MB crash depths are inferred. Cost of the event pass: 118 ms on the 813,485 B 5,580-row overlay (362 ms full libyaml load, read at every boot) and 1,287 ms on the 7,056,369 B 50,000-city gazetteer (10,095 ms full load): milliseconds, a trade on record. F5 closed: a restored backup's unparsed local rings file is refused with a log line naming it. The sites build.py:34 (3,310 B, 2.6 ms) and coverage.py:78 (1,743 B, 2.0 ms) stay on yaml.safe_load: milliseconds.
